prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
For new_screen changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
Evidence is still thin for adoption, new_flow, finish, choose_path, sign_in, and home redesign changes, as only one test has been completed for each.
The choose_path reorder change was helpful, winning Round 4 (+12.0% after noise correction).
The home redesign change was helpful, winning Round 6 (+3.6% after noise correction).
The sign_in reorder change was harmful (-6.2% after noise correction) and was stopped early.
Predictions were too high for tests with no clear effect or negative results, but underpredicted the major winning test in Round 4.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, reorder: +12.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_screen: -3.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: +3.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -6.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 89.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.1%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.7%

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Custom Photo Upload Split Redesign: Redesigns the photo upload screen into a split layout separating photo guidelines from upload inputs. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or visual glitches, and adoption step drop-off is high at 60.9% conversion.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Recovery Warning Hint: Displays a prominent hint below sign-in options reminding users to log into their original account to preserve pets. (why: 8 support emails noted pets missing or reset after signing in again with different credentials.)
2: [finish, redesign] Desktop Controls Carousel Redesign: Transforms the home intro screen into an interactive visual carousel demonstrating drag, hide, and chat controls. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% (median 395s) and 3 support emails reported confusion on controlling or hiding the pet post-onboarding.)
3: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Stage Estimated Progress: Shows a live progress bar and estimated time remaining during the background pet generation wait stage. (why: Home waiting stage has a long mean time of 2336s; clear time estimates reduce user drop-off while waiting.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Two Column Layout: Arranges path selection options side-by-side in a two-column comparison card layout. (why: Mean time in choose_path is 514s; presenting options in a balanced two-column format speeds up decision making.)
5: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Adoption Name Step Flow: Enables a step counter and structured workflow on the adoption certificate screen to guide naming and completion. (why: Adoption has a 60.9% conversion rate and 89s median time; step-by-step guidance reduces drop-off.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Explicit Account Protection Copy: Updates headline and body copy on sign-in screen to emphasize cloud saving of pet progress. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing pets due to sign-in account mix-ups; clearer messaging prevents duplicate accounts.)
7: [choose_path, redesign] Story Intro Card Redesign: Redesigns the initial intro story screen into a centered visual card presentation. (why: While median choose_path time is 8s, the long mean time (514s) indicates some users stall; a focused card layout keeps attention clear.)
8: [home, notification] Background Generation Completion Notification: Adds a notification option allowing users to minimize the app and get notified when pet creation finishes. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s; enabling desktop notifications lets users multitask without abandoning onboarding.)
